training_program.name: PPL + 3 Runs Hybrid
training_program.philosophy: Push/Pull/Legs placed so leg day never ruins tempo or long runs. Upper body can push harder. Legs always leave 2 reps in reserve.

MON.notes: Safe day — no interference with running. Can push hard.

TUE.target_pace: Comfortable and controlled (around 6:20–6:40/km based on current fitness)

WED.notes: Supports posture and running economy. Can push hard.

THU.structure: 1km easy warmup → 3–4km at tempo pace → cooldown

FRI.notes: CRITICAL RULE: Leave 2 reps in reserve. Do not max out. Legs must be fresh enough for Saturday intervals.

key_rules: Leg day = strength support, NOT bodybuilding destruction
Never train legs to failure — always 2 reps in reserve
Upper body can be pushed harder
No heavy legs before tempo or interval runs
Leg day (FRI) is always 1 day before intervals (SAT) — keep volume moderate
